{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS062 |prevtitle=Breath of the Dragonair Part 3 |nextcode=PS064 |nexttitle=Putting It on the Line...Against Arcanine |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Extricated from Exeggutor |title_ja=VS ナッシー |title_ro=VS Nassy |image=PS063.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 63 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 23 in [[The Seafoam Encounter]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 63 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |location=[[Seafoam Islands]] }} '''Extricated from Exeggutor''' (Japanese: '''VS ナッシー''' ''VS {{tt|Nassy|Exeggutor}}'') is the 63rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 23rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} and [[Pika]] are fishing, and they spot a {{p|Farfetch'd}} heading towards the sea. Pika uses {{m|Surf}} to take itself and Yellow to the spot where the Farfetch'd was going to fall. Seeing that its wing is injured, Yellow heals it and then asks it what happened to it. It is revealed that Farfetch'd no longer remembers the way to its nest, and that it was injured because the forest had attacked it. It also says that the forest changes every time, so Yellow uses [[Kitty]]'s {{m|String Shot}} to keep track of where they go. Despite the fact that they had been moving in a straight line, Yellow finds out that they had been apparently going in a circle. The forest's trees start to drop their eggs on Yellow, Pika, and Farfetch'd. Yellow commands Pika to use {{m|Thunder Shock}} which does little to stop the trees' attack. Suddenly, the trees pull their legs out of the ground. Realizing that she is unable to stop the trees, Yellow brings out Dody, hoping to be able to escape. They escape to a cliff, and Yellow notices that the forest is moving. Yellow quickly realizes that it is not a forest that is moving; it's a large group of {{p|Exeggutor}} and {{p|Oddish}}. She quickly contacts {{adv|Professor Oak}} to ask him why the Pokémon were behaving so strangely. Oak believes that a mass migration of Exeggutor and Oddish would explain why Farfetch'd would be lost. However, it wouldn't explain their migrating before their breeding season. He then theorizes that the Pokémon are sensing a terrible future event. The scene cuts to [[Cerise Island]] where [[Lance]], [[Agatha]], and [[Lorelei]] lurk. Lance announces that Pokémon are realizing that he is about to strike and then promises to defeat Yellow. Back with Yellow, Farfetch'd is able to find its nest. Yellow thinks about the future terrible event. In Oak's lab, Oak's granddaughter [[Daisy Oak]] has begun to help out. When she states that Yellow is an interesting boy, Oak explains what Yellow's goal is, stating that he believes in her. {{endspoilers}} ==Major events== {{Adventuresevents}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Daisy Oak]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Oddish}} * [[Lance's Dragonite]] ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * [[Lorelei]] * [[Bruno]] * [[Agatha]] * [[Lance]] * [[Daisy Oak]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Lance|Dragonite}}) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Lance]]'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Lance]]'s) * {{p|Farfetch'd}} * {{p|Exeggutor}} (multiple) * {{p|Oddish}} (multiple) ==Trivia== * This chapter is included in [[The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow]]. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 椰蛋樹|VS Exeggutor}} (Taiwan)
